purpose: The KYC Verification Service verifies applicants' identities by collecting and processing identity documents and submitting them to an external vendor.

components.name: kyc-orchestrator
components.evidence: kyc-orchestrator is the only component that applicants and operations tooling talk to

components.name: kyc-documents
components.evidence: kyc-documents (S3) is the bucket that holds the uploaded document images

flows.evidence: kyc-orchestrator stores document images in the kyc-documents bucket (S3)
The vendor reports results through a signed callback
